dct_description_sm: Funding for this research was provided by the Agricultural Greenhouse Gas Program (AGGP) administered by Agriculture and Agri‐Food Canada, Dairy Farmers of Canada and an NSERC Discovery Grant.

This project compared the N<sub>2</sub>O and CO<sub>2</sub> emissions between an annual cropping system (corn) and a perennial cropping system (hay), each subject to different manure application treatments. We addressed the following questions: 1) How do the net GHG budgets compare between the annual and hay crops, 2) how does the timing or method of manure application affect the GHG emissions, and 3) how do weather conditions affect GHG emissions.  GHG emissions were taken using multi-plot flux gradient methodology for 4 side-by-side 4 ha plots. Measurements were continuous.

dct_title_s: Evaluating and comparing greenhouse gas emissions from annual and perennial dairy feed cropping systems amended with dairy manure
